title: egyetért valakivel: To Agree With Someone

sections.title: Another verb that needs -val/-vel
sections.content: egyetért ("to agree") works exactly like kijön valakivel, which you already know for getting along with someone: the person you agree with takes -val/-vel, never a bare noun. Egyetértek Károllyal — "I agree with Károly". Once the person is already named, swap them for vele/veled ("with him or her/with you"), the same pronoun forms you already use everywhere else.

items.spanish: Egyetértek Károllyal, a másik szálloda jobb.
items.english: I agree with Károly, the other hotel is better.

sections.content: egyet ("one, as one") plus ért ("understand") is what's glued together here — literally "to understand as one" — but it behaves as a single, ordinary verb, just like kijön did.
